instructions_to_main_agent: 2. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to 'index.css' immediately.
3. THEME: Force dark mode in 'tailwind.config.js' or 'index.html'. The app should NEVER be light.
4. LAYOUT: Build the Homepage using the 'Bento Grid' strategy. Do not use standard stacked sections.
5. COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn for complex interactions (Dialogs, Tabs) but style them to match the 'Performance Pro' aesthetic (remove rounded corners if needed, darken backgrounds).
6. MOTION: Add 'framer-motion' entrance animations to all sections. Stagger children elements.
7. ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure all text on image backgrounds has sufficient contrast. Use 'bg-black/50' overlays where necessary.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'AI slop' designs (centered text, standard Bootstrap layouts).
Do not use gradients for text unless it's a very subtle shine effect.
